note: Generated by "som_gameplay.py menu". Option keys are the keys of the option file passed to "som_gameplay.py apply --options". Convert types when writing the file: enum -> string (numeric-looking values as integers), bool yes/no -> true/false, num -> integer, an empty optional num is left out. Applied AFTER the ROM is generated; not a generator setting.

apply.command: python3 tools/gameplay/som_gameplay.py apply --rom IN.sfc --options OPTIONS.json --out OUT.sfc --on-conflict skip
apply.on_conflict: skip drops only the conflicting option and reports it on stderr

supported_roms: randomizer ROMs (Ancient Cave, Open World, Randomizer, Boss Rush, Chaos)

options.label: Weapon recharge
options.help: Heroes only. Weapon recharge gauge E1ED loaded after a swing / interrupted charge. vanilla (100-Agi)/2+50 frames; fast (100-Agi)/2; faster (100-Agi)/8; instant 0. Monsters unchanged.

options.label: Run recharge
options.help: Gauge loaded when a run (A press) ends. vanilla 50-100 frames; fast (100-Agi)/2; none 0.

options.label: Charge build-up
options.help: Weapon charge build-up per stage: vanilla 90 frames, fast 45, faster 22, instant 1 (all stages in a few frames).

options.label: Charge frames per stage
options.help: Overrides charge_speed with an exact frames-per-stage value (1..90).

options.label: Speed Up speeds charge
options.help: While the hero has the Speed Up buff (E1B0 bits 04+10) a stage takes half the frames. Do not combine with the randomizer Speedup hack.

options.label: Charge-boost equipment id
options.help: Equipped head/body/accessory id (E1E0-E1E2) that halves the acts per stage like Speed Up. Item ids differ between ROMs.

options.label: Weapon level progress
options.help: Multiplier of the weapon-level progress per kill. Conflicts with the randomizer fasterWeaponLevel hook (default on there).

options.label: Monster flinch
options.help: Ordinary monsters only (bosses and heroes unchanged, lethal hits unchanged). strong: flinch only when hit by magic or a critical; heavy: also when damage > maxHP/4; never: no hit reaction.

options.label: Hero flinch
options.help: Hero hit reaction (knock-back, charge interrupted by the reaction). light: no reaction unless damage > maxHP/4; never: no reaction (lethal hits unchanged). Shares the C0:4EBC site with monster_flinch.

options.label: Girl critical bonus
options.help: Added to the critical chance (/256) of hero slot 1 (vanilla 10). Chance is a byte: keep base+bonus < 256.

options.label: Boy and Sprite critical bonus
options.help: Added to the critical chance (/256) of hero slots 0 and 2 (vanilla 5).

options.label: Critical multiplier
options.help: Damage multiplier of a critical hit (vanilla 2). Damage is still capped at 999 per hit.

options.label: Walk speed
options.help: Hero walking speed in pixels per frame (vanilla 2, run is 3). Conflicts with the randomizer funSpeedup hack.

options.label: Chests open instantly
options.help: Treasure chests open without the lock-breaking shake: the three animation scripts end at once (idea: Zhade, Moppleton).

options.label: Full damage when swinging early
options.help: A swing made before the weapon gauge is full no longer loses half its damage on top of the gauge ratio (vanilla halves it twice); a ready swing is unchanged (idea: the SoM editor community fix, Moppleton).

options.label: No fade on map transitions
options.help: Map fades jump to the target brightness at once (door and exit transitions are shorter, may show brief graphic glitches) (idea: Moppleton).

options.label: Faster screen fades
options.help: Every screen fade runs twice as fast (one brightness step per half the frames) and keeps the fade look. Redundant with qol_fast_transitions.

options.label: Item stack limit
options.help: Maximum stack of one consumable: 4 (vanilla) or 7, the largest the inventory byte can hold (idea: Masterflow item limit patch, Moppleton).

options.label: Level-up refills MP
options.help: A level-up also refills MP (vanilla refills HP only) (idea: Moppleton). A randomizer ROM that already has the same hook is left alone.

options.label: Fallen heroes gain experience
options.help: Fallen party members still receive experience from kills; they level up but stay at 0 HP (idea: AdmiralStiff). Works on top of the randomizer level-up hook.

options.label: Spell level progress
options.help: Multiplier of the spell-level progress per cast (vanilla 1). A randomizer ROM with the fasterMagicLevel hook (x4) is left alone (idea: Kethinov spell grinding hack, Moppleton).

options.label: Screen scroll window
options.help: Size of the window in which the hero can walk before the screen scrolls: vanilla x 56-199 y 72-175, tight x 80-175 y 80-159, tighter x 96-159 y 96-143 (idea: Binarynova).

options.label: Ring menu speed
options.help: Ring menu speed: 2 turns the ring twice as fast and opens and closes it in fewer frames; the rest positions are the same as in vanilla (idea: the ring code mapped in this project).

options.label: Shops fill the stack
options.help: Buying a consumable in a shop fills the stack in one go: it keeps buying the same item while the stack has room and the money covers it (idea: Moppleton BuyMultipleItems).

options.label: Top-of-screen message time
options.help: Messages at the top of the screen (level-ups, items found, weapon and spell levels) stay 1/2 or 1/4 as long (idea: Moppleton FasterTopOfScreenDialogue).

presets.name: Vanilla
presets.description: No change: the ROM is left byte-identical.

presets.name: Quick Combat
presets.description: Short waits between swings, quick charge, ordinary enemies only flinch from magic and critical hits.

presets.name: Arcade
presets.description: No weapon wait, instant-ish charge, heroes shrug off small hits, triple criticals, brisk walking.

presets.name: Quality of life
presets.description: Shorter animations and fades, 7 items per stack, MP on level-up, fallen heroes still gain experience.
